def sources():
    recipe = json.loads((ROOT / 'engine/sticker_recipe.json').read_bytes())
    base = ROOT / 'engine/tests/AITest.java'
    dependency = ROOT / recipe['packaged_testng']['path']
    assert file_hash(base) == recipe['packaged_ai_base_sha256']
    assert file_hash(dependency) == recipe['packaged_testng']['sha256']
    return [base, FIXTURE], dependency


def worker(run):
    settings = read_settings(BUILD / 'engine-config.json')
    engine = settings.verify()
    metadata = json.loads((run / 'rules-inputs.json').read_bytes())
    assert all(file_hash(Path(path)) == digest for path, digest in metadata['inputs'].items())
    output = run / 'rules-classes'
    assert metadata['classes'] == {path.relative_to(output).as_posix(): file_hash(path)
                                   for path in output.rglob('*.class')}
    _, dependency = sources()

    java = importlib.import_module('jpype')
    archive = settings.home / engine['jar_name']

              'failures': [str(result.getThrowable()) for result in listener.getFailedTests()]}
    (run / 'evidence.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8'))
    print(json.dumps({'counts': counts, 'failures': record['failures']}), flush=True)
    java.shutdownJVM()


def parent():

    selected, dependency = sources()
    rules._compile(settings, run, selected, dependency)
    with _engine_profile(settings, run):

    record = json.loads((run / 'evidence.json').read_bytes())
    assert record['configuration_failures'] == record['configuration_skips'] == 0

    else:
        assert len(sys.argv) == 1
        parent()
